messages:
Maria S: FYI escalation from support — HelioMed onboarding blocked. They hit a legal/data consent hold for embedding ingestion. Error in our inbound pipeline: `consent_required`.
Jake (CS): ack. Can you paste the ticket and contract id? I’ll draft comms and loop legal. :eyes:
Maria S: ticket #SUP-4821, contract ref H-MED-2026. Customer says they need a privacy addendum signed before we can ingest PHI-like docs. Link: https://redwood.internal/tickets/SUP-4821
Lee (Solutions): technical ask — what exactly are they trying to ingest? if it's de-identified, we can offer a staging ingest with restricted logging while legal reviews. Also need to know model + embedding config.
Nina (AE): heads up — renewal in ~60 days. If onboarding stalls we risk churn. I can offer a 30-day complimentary pilot extension to buy time, but need CS + legal to sign off on the plan.
Jake (CS): draft comms plan idea: 1) immediate acknowledgement to customer + ETA for legal review (24-48h) 2) offer staging ingest with logs disabled 3) provide privacy addendum for signature or pointer to existing corporate PoE 4) weekly check-ins until ingest confirmed. Anyone object?
Maria S: that's good. Support already told customer 48h for the legal step, will keep that. Customer contact is emma@heliomed.co, primary technical contact is d.choi.
Lee (Solutions): can we prepare a minimal sample pipeline for staging? I can drop a config snippet:
```
# staging ingest
logging: reduced
kv_cache: disabled
embed_model: redwood-open-1.3
access: allow-temporary-token
```
Lee (Solutions): deployable in our sandbox within 6-8 hours if legal approves restricted logging.
legal-bot: New intake created: L-789. Assigned to @legal-team. Estimated triage: 1 business day. Attachments required: contract H-MED-2026, description of data fields being ingested.
Jake (CS): Nina — if you offer the 30-day extension, let's make it contingent on signing the addendum and agreeing to the staging controls. I'll draft a short email template.
Nina (AE): ok will prepare conditional extension verbiage. Send me the template.
Jake (CS): template (WIP):
"Hi Emma — thanks for the flag. We’re escalating to Legal to finalize a privacy addendum. To keep onboarding progress we can enable a staging ingest with restricted logging while Legal reviews. If Legal confirms within 14 days we’ll proceed; as a gesture we’ll extend your pilot by 30 days contingent on signing the addendum. More details to follow. — Jake"
Maria S: Support note: customer very sensitive about PHI wording. Please avoid using PHI in external comms; use "sensitive health data" instead. Also asked for named POA contact for legal.
Jake (CS): noted. Will update language. @legal-bot can you prioritise and confirm intake receipt to the thread when triaged?
legal-bot: Intake L-789 acknowledged. Will post triage outcome here. :white_check_mark:
support-bot: SUP-4821 status -> escalated_to_cs @1938456789
Lee (Solutions): I'll queue the sandbox config and hold deployment until legal ok. ETA standby.
Nina (AE): I’ll call the customer after lunchtime to reassure and set expectations. Keep me posted on legal ETA.
Jake (CS): action items: Maria — add contract + customer POA to ticket. Lee — ready staging config but hold. Nina — customer touch. Legal — triage L-789. I’ll post an official comms note when Legal confirms. :thumbsup:
Maria S: added attachments to SUP-4821. tagging emma contact. :white_check_mark:
legal-bot: Triage complete: assigned to @sara.legal, estimated resolution 2 business days pending addendum drafting.
Jake (CS): thanks — will follow up tomorrow EOD for status. If legal needs examples of our staging controls, ping Lee.
Nina (AE): agreed. thanks everyone.
Maria S: closing loop on support side for now. Will update if customer pushes for faster timeline
